target: All 8956 official English small-version test queries, 181701 candidate pairs, 164900 unique products
primary_comparison: All three enrichment fields versus plain BM25, NDCG@10 mean paired difference and 95% query bootstrap interval
secondary_comparisons: Individual fields versus plain; NDCG-full, Exact MRR, Exact-at-1, Exact-recall@10. Exploratory intervals, no multiple-comparison significance claims.
corpus: 164900 distinct test candidate products for every variant; plain rerun on this corpus, each variant recomputes IDF and average document length
generation: Eight-product batches; up to two individual retry passes for invalid outputs. Durable $4.40 budget for new pipeline.
limits: Candidate-ranking evaluation; incomplete judgments cannot establish whole-catalog recall; no conversational or deployment-latency claims.
